description: Same check as entity_evidence_check for 1-10 Japanese organizations in one call (by corporate number, exact name or registration number): per company the full evidence with each section's source, retrieval time, version date and what was not checked, plus a summary counting resolved, name-only, ambiguous, not found and unknown, and unavailable sources. Ambiguous names are never resolved by guess. Not charged if no company can be checked. Not a compliance determination.

companies.description: 1 to 10 companies, each with the same fields as entity_evidence_check (corporate_number, name, edinet_code, registration_numbers, prefecture, address_hint, domain); order kept

address_hint.description: Part of the address (Japanese script accepted) to tie a name to one gBizINFO corporate number

corporate_number.description: 13-digit corporate number, e.g. 3010401049814 (NTA registry not yet connected)

domain.description: Optional website domain, e.g. example.com. Never resolved to an organization (identity.domain is unverified)

name.description: Organization name as registered (Japanese script accepted). A person-like name is screened only against the MOF list

prefecture.description: Prefecture to narrow the ISA, gBizINFO and CAA name searches, e.g. Tokyo

fsa.description: FSA registration number as written in the FSA register

ssw.description: ISA registered support organization number as written in the register

detail.description: true: all records and receipts (default compact)

name: entity_evidence_batch

receipt_id.description: Receipt id of the settled paid call ("rcpt_" + 64 hex). Use with get_receipt.

results.description: One result per company, in input order.

detail.description: false = compact answer (default); true = every matched record and full receipts.

resolution.description: gBizINFO name search: every candidate number; bound only when exactly one exact-name candidate remains.

used_for_lookups.description: Corporate number used to look up number-based sections (input, the only gBizINFO exact-name candidate, or the number stated in an FSA record); null if none.

domain.description: A domain given in the input is never resolved to an organization (always unverified).

not_covered.description: What this service does not cover (detail=true; also in /llms.txt).

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

sections.description: One section per registry, in the common registry-status shape.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

could_not_be_checked.description: Everything not checked, with the reason (including the NTA corporate number registry, not yet connected).

evidence.description: The same answer as entity_evidence_check for this company (null if not completed or invalid).

not_completed.description: Companies whose check did not finish within the batch time limit or failed (identity_resolution unknown).

sources_unavailable.description: Relays that failed or were unreachable, with the indexes of the companies affected; their sections are unknown.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError true when payment is required or was not accepted).

outputSchema.description: Either the paid result (with receipt_id) or, with isError true, the x402 PaymentRequired to pay and retry.

title: Japan entity evidence: batch of 1-10 companies (paid)
